outcome: discharge home with spontaneous breathing of room air
cohort: Two premature infants with gestational ages of 23 and 24 weeks, diagnosed with neonatal ARDS, who developed acute worsening of oxygenation on the 30th and 28th day of life, respectively.
finding: The combination of intratracheal budesonide and surfactant may be a novel therapeutic option in the treatment of neonatal ARDS, showing a positive short-term response and leading to survival and discharge for the two reported cases.
